name: Shahu, Phule, Ambedkar Award
benefit:
The institute will be given ₹15,00,000/- as a prize along with a Memento and a Silver Krol Citation.
A total of 7 awards will be given for 7 regions.
_eligibility_text:
1. The Institute/Organization should be located within the state of Maharashtra.
1. The Institute/Organization should have done work in the field of Social Justice in the state of Maharashtra.
1. The period of the Social Service should be 15 years & above in the state of Maharashtra.
